articles.summary: Needham Bank announced today that it is participating in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts' Investing for the Long-Term Initiative (Invest MA), a statewide program designed to expand access to capital for creditworthy small businesses. Through Invest MA, administered by the Massachusetts State Treasurer's Office, state cash deposits are placed with participating Massachusetts banks that commit to increasing small business lending. The program makes up to $500 million available for deposit across participating institutions, enabling Needham Bank to provide additional financing to Massachusetts small businesses and nonprofits seeking to grow, hire employees, invest in their operations, and strengthen their communities. "Small businesses are essential to the strength and vitality of the communities we serve," said Joseph P. Campanelli, President and CEO of Needham Bank. articles.summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq Capital Market: NBBK), the holding company of Needham Bank (the "Bank"), today announced its third quarter 2026 financial results. SELECTED FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER OF 2026 Net income for the third quarter of 2026 amounted to $23.1 million, or $0.58 per diluted common share, compared to net income of $21.1 million, or $0.53 per diluted common share, for the prior quarter. Return on average assets and return on average equity for the third quarter of 2026 were 1.23% and 10.73%, respectively, representing increases from 1.17% and 10.03%, respectively, for the prior quarter. Operating net income (1) for the third quarter of 2026 increased 8.9% and amounted to $23.8 million, or $0.60 per diluted common share, compared to operating net income (1) of $21.9 million, or $0.55 per diluted common share, for the prior quarter.
